title: Una birra
desc: One beer, and the door that opens after eleven
setting: Friday, plastic chairs on a corner, a cooler on the floor, and Marcos holding up one finger.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: Una birra y nos vamos, vos.
steps.en: One beer and we are off.

options.en: Sure. Like when you say ahorita.
options.feedback: You caught the joke inside his promise. Nobody who has been here two years still believes the one beer.
Agreed. He will order the second round and you will still be there at midnight.
Announcing the exit before the first bottle is opened is a strange way to arrive.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.en: Doña! Two beers, good and cold.

options.feedback: Getting in early on the rounds is how you stop being the one who never orders.
Fine tonight. Over a year, the man who only says gracias gets a name.

options.es: Yo pago la mía nada más.
options.en: I will pay for just mine.
options.feedback: Splitting it bottle by bottle is not how that cooler works.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: (llegando sin avisar) Ideay, ¿y no me llamaron?
steps.en: (arriving unannounced) Ideay, and nobody called me?

options.es: Vos siempre caés solo, no hay que llamarte.
options.en: You always turn up on your own, nobody needs to call you.
options.feedback: Given back with a smile. Nobody called him and everybody knew he was coming.
Warm and correct. The joke was sitting there unclaimed.

options.en: We did not know you wanted to come.
options.feedback: Too careful. It sounds like he was left out, which now he half was.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: (a las once) Mi papá tenía una moto igualita.
steps.en: (at eleven) My father had a motorbike just like that.

options.feedback: The tone changed. He has not talked about his father in nine years and the whole table just went quiet with him.
Kind, and it asks him to perform it. He will get there on his own.

options.es: Jaja, ¿y qué le pasó a la moto?
options.en: Ha, and what happened to the bike?
options.feedback: You answered the serious register with the joking one. Everybody heard it.
